segments.text: At the library we kept getting books back with a blue envelope tucked inside. I thought a patron was forgetting their mail.
The librarian finally opened one. It said, I finished my first whole book. Please put this in the next one you lend my dad.
It was a kid leaving his dad progress reports. After that we put an envelope in every book his dad checked out.
The kitchen timer keeps going off in the middle of my streams. I asked my roommate to put it somewhere I could never hear it.
Sorry, that was loud. Hold on.
I found the kitchen timer. My roommate sent it to my mom, and she calls me every time it goes off.
